subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps & demo time options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps & demo time options

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call:
- Primary goals: reduce per-query latency for search re-rank, unify embeddings pipeline across squads, and lower inference cost at 95th percentile.
- Key constraints: PCI scope for checkout logs, EU data residency for segmentation models, and a mix of US/EU/APAC stakeholders for the rollout.

Next step: we recommend a 45-minute technical deep dive + demo with our infra lead to walk through routing, batching and a short config walkthrough. To make calendar coordination simpler across your distributed team, here are a few rotating slot proposals (we can rotate weekly so the same folks don't always take early/late times):

Option A (US-first week):
- Wed 07:00 PT / Wed 15:00 GMT / Wed 23:00 SGT
Option B (EU-first week):
- Wed 12:00 PT / Wed 20:00 GMT / Thu 04:00 SGT
Option C (APAC-friendly week):
- Thu 00:00 PT / Thu 08:00 GMT / Thu 16:00 SGT

If those are too awkward, please suggest 2-3 time windows (your local time) and we'll propose a rotating cadence that covers US, EU, and APAC over a 3-week cycle. I’m also sharing a quick Calendly link to pick a slot if that’s easier: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-45

Attached is a short draft demo agenda — feel free to suggest edits.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Herrera <th@globaltech.io>
Date: 2027-02-10T17:40:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps & demo time options

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the options. Overall this looks good — we'd like the deep dive to include our infra and security counterparts (Tom will join for the security discussion). Our core team availability: Mon–Thu 14:00–18:00 CET is best for the EU folks; APAC will be joining early mornings CET some weeks.

Preference: Option B (EU-first week) works better for us, but we like the idea of rotating so APAC/US colleagues are not always on the late/early slots. Can we do a rotation every other week (EU-first one week, US-first the next)?

I ran the Calendly link quickly — I can make Wed Feb 16 at 16:00 CET (which should be 07:00 PT) if that works for your team. If you need a different slot, propose two alternatives and we'll confirm.

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen | Product Ops Manager, Acme Retail
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T20:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps & demo time options

Hi Alice —

Perfect — Wed Feb 16, 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT works for us. We'll set it up as a recurring rotating cadence:
- Week 1 (Feb 16): EU-first (16:00 CET / 07:00 PT / 00:00 SGT)
- Week 2: US-first (09:00 PT / 17:00 GMT / 01:00 SGT)
- Week 3: APAC-friendly (00:00 PT / 08:00 GMT / 16:00 SGT)

We can rotate every week or every other week — happy to align with your team preference. I'll book the first session for Feb 16 and set it as \"occurs weekly\" but will label the invite \"rotating time slots — week pattern\" and include a note to skip/adjust on weeks that don't fit. If you prefer every-other-week, let me know and I will change the recurrence.

Invite and agenda attached. Dev, Aditya — please confirm you'll join as the infra lead for Feb 16.

Thanks,
Marissa
[Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2027-02-11T02:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps & demo time options

Sounds good — I can join Feb 16 at 16:00 CET. I'll be prepared to walk through routing policies, KV cache behavior, and a quick live perf run against a small sample to show latency/throughput tradeoffs.

Marissa, I'll wait for the calendar invite and will add a short slide (1–2) on the proposed canary rollout plan.

— Aditya
